data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google Analytics for Firebase.
data.what_it_does: Provides an app measurement solution that gives insight into app usage and user engagement on Android, iOS, web, and macOS. Connects your Flutter application to the Firebase Analytics API.
use_when: You need to track user engagement and app usage statistics.
Your project already utilizes Firebase services.
avoid_when: You require self-hosted or offline-only analytics without Google services.
Your project does not use Firebase.
strengths: Official Firebase plugin supporting multiple platforms including web and macOS.
Integrates seamlessly with other Firebase products.
weaknesses: Requires proper Firebase project configuration and initialization.
Tied strictly to Google Firebase ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a Firebase project and configuring the app for Android, iOS, web, or macOS following the Firebase documentation.

alternatives.name: firebase_crashlytics
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to track crashes and error reports instead of standard user analytics.

alternatives.name: firebase_remote_config
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to change the behavior and appearance of your app without publishing an app update.
